# LangSlice

> LangSlice registers histology brain sections to BrainGlobe atlases. A user's coding-agent app (Codex, Antigravity, Claude Code) creates a job folder for one brain with `langslice-job FOLDER init`, launches one registration agent with the prompt `langslice-job FOLDER launch --role register|register-scripting` writes, and checks the saved pictures. Install from source into the conda environment of environment.yml.

Rules for an agent setting up a registration: never register sections yourself; put the user's notes in the job (`init --notes`); pass `result.prompt` of `launch` to the registration agent unchanged; run `launch` again for each launch; judge the result by its pictures, not the agent's summary.

## For agents

- [Install LangSlice (for agents)](https://langslice.readthedocs.io/en/latest/agents/install.html): source install, verification, connecting Codex, Antigravity and Claude Code
- [The agent CLI](https://langslice.readthedocs.io/en/latest/agents/cli.html): jobs, launch prompts, verbs, replies, background runs, the job's Python environment
- [The MCP server](https://langslice.readthedocs.io/en/latest/agents/mcp.html): `langslice mcp`, `start_job`
- [The built-in agent](https://langslice.readthedocs.io/en/latest/agents/builtin.html): `langslice linear run`, its own flags, spend, logs

- [Tools and options](https://langslice.readthedocs.io/en/latest/reference/tools.html): every registration tool, its arguments, what a job can switch off
- [Job settings](https://langslice.readthedocs.io/en/latest/reference/settings.html): every `init` setting with its flag, default and when to change it
- [Job folder and file formats](https://langslice.readthedocs.io/en/latest/reference/file_formats.html): the job folder, coordinate conventions, maps, exports, importing a registration
